{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that revenue is now numeric
print("Revenue dtype after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Confirm there are no missing values in revenue
print("Missing values in revenue after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())"}
